title: SystemArea
description:
Typed view of the System area.

Fields are ordered the same way they appear in the byte layout. Grouped: `direct.*` covers offsets 0x03..=0x04; `midi.*` covers offsets 0x09..=0x11.

carryover.description: Carry the echo/reverb tail over when switching memories.

ctl1_function.description: Function assigned to the CTL1 footswitch / external pedal.

ctl2_function.description: Function assigned to the CTL2 footswitch / external pedal.

input_source.description: Audio input source: instrument (Guitar) or Line level.

memory_extent.description: Number of memory slots (1..=4) cycled by the MEMORY footswitch.

midi.description: MIDI configuration: channels, message filters, and sync.

time_mode.description: Global delay-time range: Normal (≤1000 ms) or Long (≤2000 ms). Each memory also stores its own Time Mode, which takes precedence for the active patch's tap-time ceiling.

Ctl1Function.description: Function the CTL1 footswitch / external pedal performs.

Ctl2Function.description: Function the CTL2 footswitch / external pedal performs.

mode.description: Direct-signal voicing: clean Analog, or RE-201 Simulate.

on.description: Whether the direct (dry) signal passes through alongside the effect.

InputSource.description: Audio input source — instrument (Guitar) or Line level.

MidiChannel.description:
MIDI Rx channel — `off` or `1..=16`.

YAML: `off` or an integer 1..=16.

cc_in.description: Receive Control Change to set parameters.

cc_out.description: Send Control Change when a knob is moved.

pc_in.description: Receive Program Change to switch memories.

pc_out.description: Send Program Change when the active memory changes.

realtime_source.description: Source of MIDI realtime messages (start/stop/clock): Internal or MIDI.

sync_source.description: Tempo sync source: Internal, or Auto (follow incoming clock).

thru.description: Echo incoming MIDI back out the MIDI OUT / THRU port.

RealtimeSource.description: Source of MIDI realtime messages (start / stop / clock).

TimeMode.description: Delay-time range: Normal (≤1000 ms) or Long (≤2000 ms).

TxChannel.description:
MIDI Tx channel — `off`, `1..=16`, or `rx` (follows RX channel).

YAML: `off`, `rx`, or an integer 1..=16.
